cards.title: 음높이
cards.summary: 소리가 높거나 낮게 들리는 성질
cards.description:
음높이는 소리가 높거나 낮게 지각되는 성질이다. 일정한 음의 경우 진동이 더 빠를수록 대체로 높게 들린다. 같은 피아노에서 가운데 도보다 오른쪽 도가 높다. 세게 눌러도 같은 건반이면 음높이는 같다.

### 악보 예시

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C2 c2 |
```

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

en-US.title: Pitch
en-US.summary: How high or low a sound is perceived
en-US.description:
Pitch is how high or low a sound seems. For a steady tone, faster vibration usually sounds higher. On a piano the C to the right of middle C sounds higher. Pressing the same key harder does not change its pitch.

### Score example

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C2 c2 |
```

### References

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

ja.title: 音高
ja.summary: 音が高いか低いかの聞こえ方
ja.description:
音高は音の高さの感じ方である。周期的な音は振動が速いほどふつう高く聞こえる。ピアノで中央のドの右にあるドはより高い。同じ鍵を強く押しても音高は変わらない。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C2 c2 |
```

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

zh-TW.title: 音高
zh-TW.summary: 聲音聽起來有多高或多低
zh-TW.description:
音高是對聲音高低的感受。對穩定的音而言，振動通常越快就聽起來越高。鋼琴中央 do 右側的 do 較高。同一個琴鍵按得更用力，音高並不改變。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C2 c2 |
```

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

cards.title: 오선
cards.summary: 음표를 줄과 칸에 배치하는 다섯 개의 평행선
cards.description:
오선은 음표를 적는 다섯 줄과 그 사이 네 칸이다. 아래에서 위로 올라갈수록 보통 높은 음을 적는다. 어느 자리가 도인지 읽으려면 음자리표를 함께 확인한다.

### 악보 예시

![오선 예시 악보](asset:music-common-staff-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
E F G A |
```

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

en-US.title: Staff
en-US.summary: Five parallel lines with spaces for writing notes
en-US.description:
A staff has five lines and four spaces for notes. Higher positions usually represent higher notes. The clef tells you which position corresponds to a particular pitch.

### Score example

![Example score for Staff](asset:music-common-staff-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
E F G A |
```

### References

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

ja.title: 五線
ja.summary: 音符を線上や間に置く五本の平行線
ja.description:
五線には五本の線と四つの間がある。ふつう上に行くほど高い音を表す。どの位置がドに当たるかは音部記号で決まる。

### 譜例

![五線の譜例](asset:music-common-staff-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
E F G A |
```

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

zh-TW.title: 五線譜
zh-TW.summary: 用線與間的位置記寫音符的五條平行線
zh-TW.description:
五線譜有五條線與四個間。位置越高，通常代表音越高。哪個位置代表 do，要看所用的譜號。

### 譜例

![五線譜的譜例](asset:music-common-staff-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
E F G A |
```

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

cards.title: 음자리표
cards.summary: 오선의 한 자리에 기준 음을 지정하는 표시
cards.description:
음자리표는 오선의 위치와 음이름을 연결한다. 높은음자리표는 아래에서 둘째 줄을 G(솔)로, 낮은음자리표는 넷째 줄을 F(파)로 지정한다. 위치가 같은 음표도 음자리표가 다르면 다른 음일 수 있다.

### 악보 예시

![음자리표 예시 악보](asset:music-common-clef-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
G2 c2 |
```

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

ko.title: 음자리표
ko.summary: 오선의 한 자리에 기준 음을 지정하는 표시
ko.description:
음자리표는 오선의 위치와 음이름을 연결한다. 높은음자리표는 아래에서 둘째 줄을 G(솔)로, 낮은음자리표는 넷째 줄을 F(파)로 지정한다. 위치가 같은 음표도 음자리표가 다르면 다른 음일 수 있다.

en-US.title: Clef
en-US.summary: A sign that assigns a reference pitch to a staff position
en-US.description:
A clef links staff positions to pitch names. The treble clef sets the second line from the bottom to G, and the bass clef sets the fourth line to F. The same note position can read differently in two clefs.

### Score example

![Example score for Clef](asset:music-common-clef-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
G2 c2 |
```

### References

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

ja.title: 音部記号
ja.summary: 五線の特定の位置に基準となる音を指定する記号
ja.description:
音部記号は五線の位置と音名を結びつける。ト音記号では下から二番目の線がソ、ヘ音記号では四番目の線がファになる。同じ位置でも音部記号が違えば別の音になることがある。

### 譜例

![音部記号の譜例](asset:music-common-clef-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
G2 c2 |
```

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

zh-TW.title: 譜號
zh-TW.summary: 指定五線譜上某個位置代表哪一個基準音的符號
zh-TW.description:
譜號把五線譜的位置和音名連起來。高音譜號把從下數第二線指定為 G，低音譜號則把第四線指定為 F。同一位置的音符可能因譜號不同而代表不同的音。

### 譜例

![譜號的譜例](asset:music-common-clef-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
G2 c2 |
```

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

cards.title: 반음
cards.summary: 12평균율에서 옥타브를 열두 등분한 한 칸
cards.description:
피아노에서 흰색과 검은색을 모두 포함해 바로 옆 건반으로 움직이는 간격이 반음이다. 가운데 도에서 다음 높은 도까지는 반음 열두 개가 있다. E–F처럼 붙어 있는 흰건반도 한 반음 차이다.

### 악보 예시

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C2 _D2 |
```

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Intervals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/intervals/)

ko.summary: 12평균율에서 옥타브를 열두 등분한 한 칸

en-US.title: Semitone
en-US.summary: One of the twelve equal steps in an octave in equal temperament
en-US.description:
On a piano a semitone is the distance to the immediately adjacent key, whether black or white. There are twelve such steps from middle C to the next C above it. E and F are adjacent white keys.

### Score example

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C2 _D2 |
```

### References

[Open Music Theory · Intervals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/intervals/)

ja.title: 半音
ja.summary: 十二平均律でオクターブを十二等分した一区間
ja.description:
ピアノで白鍵と黒鍵の両方を数え、すぐ隣の鍵への間隔を半音という。中央のドから次に高いドまでに半音が十二ある。白鍵のミとファも隣り合っている。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C2 _D2 |
```

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Intervals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/intervals/)

zh-TW.title: 半音
zh-TW.summary: 十二平均律將八度等分成十二格時的一格
zh-TW.description:
鋼琴的黑鍵和白鍵都要算，緊鄰的兩個琴鍵相差一個半音。中央 do 到下一個更高的 do 共有十二個半音。E 和 F 雖然都是白鍵，仍相鄰。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C2 _D2 |
```

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Intervals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/intervals/)

cards.title: 변화표
cards.summary: 음표 바로 앞에서 그 음을 올리거나 내리거나 되돌리는 표시
cards.description:
변화표는 음표 앞에서 음높이를 바꾸는 기호다. 올림표 ♯는 반음 올리고, 내림표 ♭는 반음 내리며, 제자리표 ♮는 올림이나 내림을 취소한다. 오선보에서는 보통 같은 마디의 같은 옥타브 위치에도 이어서 적용된다.

### 악보 예시

![변화표 예시 악보](asset:music-common-accidental-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
F ^F =F F |
```

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

ko.summary: 음표 바로 앞에서 그 음을 올리거나 내리거나 되돌리는 표시
ko.description:
변화표는 음표 앞에서 음높이를 바꾸는 기호다. 올림표 ♯는 반음 올리고, 내림표 ♭는 반음 내리며, 제자리표 ♮는 올림이나 내림을 취소한다. 오선보에서는 보통 같은 마디의 같은 옥타브 위치에도 이어서 적용된다.

en-US.title: Accidental
en-US.summary: A sign before a note that raises, lowers, or restores its pitch
en-US.description:
An accidental alters a written pitch. A sharp raises it a semitone, a flat lowers it a semitone, and a natural cancels a sharp or flat. In standard notation its effect normally carries through the measure for the same staff position.

### Score example

![Example score for Accidental](asset:music-common-accidental-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
F ^F =F F |
```

### References

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

ja.title: 臨時記号
ja.summary: 音符の前で音を上げる、下げる、または元に戻す記号
ja.description:
臨時記号は書かれた音の高さを変える。♯は半音上げ、♭は半音下げ、♮はその変化を取り消す。通常は同じ小節内の同じ高さの位置にも効く。

### 譜例

![臨時記号の譜例](asset:music-common-accidental-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
F ^F =F F |
```

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

zh-TW.title: 臨時記號
zh-TW.summary: 寫在音符前，用來升高、降低或還原音高的符號
zh-TW.description:
臨時記號會改變寫出的音高。♯ 升高一個半音，♭ 降低一個半音，♮ 取消升降。在一般五線譜中，它通常也適用於同一小節中相同位置的音。

### 譜例

![臨時記號的譜例](asset:music-common-accidental-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
F ^F =F F |
```

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Fundamentals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/part/fundamentals/)

cards.title: 박
cards.summary: 음이 없을 때도 일정한 간격으로 손뼉을 맞춰 셀 수 있는 시간 단위
cards.description:
박은 리듬을 들을 때 일정하게 셀 수 있는 시간의 단위다. 한 박에 음이 두 개 나올 수도 있고 쉼으로 비어 있을 수도 있다. 아래 예에서는 발로 한 번 짚을 때마다 음이 두 번 난다.

### 악보 예시

```abc

M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
CC CC CC CC |
```

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

en-US.title: Beat
en-US.summary: An evenly recurring point you can tap even during silences
en-US.description:
A beat is a unit of the steady pulse in a rhythm. It can contain two notes or be silent. In this example two sounds fit each tap of your foot.

### Score example

```abc
Q:1/4=96
```

ja.title: 拍
ja.summary: 音がなくても等間隔に手で取れる時間の単位
ja.description:
拍はリズムの中で一定の間隔で数えられる時間の単位である。一拍に二つの音が入ることも、休みになることもある。この例では足を一度踏む間に音が二回鳴る。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
CC CC CC CC |
```

zh-TW.title: 拍點
zh-TW.summary: 即使沒有音符發聲，仍能等間隔拍手數出的時間單位
zh-TW.description:
拍點是聽節奏時能規律數出的時間單位。一拍可以有兩個音，也可以是休止。這個例子每踏一次腳會聽到兩個音。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
CC CC CC CC |
```

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

en-US.title: Tempo
en-US.summary: The rate at which the musical pulse repeats
en-US.description:
Tempo is how fast the beat moves. A marking of quarter note = 96 specifies 96 quarter-note beats per minute. A piece in 4/4 can be performed slowly or quickly.

### Score example

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C C C C |
```

### References

ja.title: テンポ
ja.summary: 一定の拍が繰り返される速さ
ja.description:

zh-TW.title: 速度
zh-TW.summary: 規律拍點重複得多快

cards.title: 박자
cards.summary: 박을 묶을 때 강한 자리와 약한 자리가 되풀이되는 방식
cards.description:
박자는 박을 되풀이되는 단위로 묶는 방식이다. 4/4는 보통 4분음표 길이의 박 네 개를 한 마디로 묶는다. 6/8은 보통 8분음표 세 개 길이의 큰 박 두 개로 느낀다. 3/4에서는 같은 길이의 여섯 8분음표를 2+2+2로, 6/8에서는 보통 3+3으로 묶어 센다.

![A는 3/4로 8분음표 여섯 개가 2+2+2, B는 6/8로 3+3으로 묶인 악보](asset:music-common-triple-compound-score)

### 들어 보기

같은 도 여섯 음이 같은 간격으로 나옵니다. A에서는 첫째·셋째·다섯째 음, B에서는 첫째·넷째 음에서 발을 한 번씩 구르며 큰 박이 각각 세 번과 두 번 느껴지는지 들어 보세요.

각 예시는 같은 마디를 두 번 들려줍니다. 첫 마디를 들은 뒤 다음 마디에서 큰 박만 손으로 짚어 보세요.

en-US.title: Meter
en-US.summary: The repeating pattern of stronger and weaker positions in grouped beats
en-US.description:
Meter groups beats into a repeating pattern. In 4/4 a measure usually contains four quarter-note beats. In 6/8 it usually feels like two large beats, each the length of three eighth notes. Six eighth notes are grouped 2+2+2 in 3/4 and typically 3+3 in 6/8.

![Score A beams six eighth notes as 2+2+2 in 3/4. Score B beams them as 3+3 in 6/8.](asset:music-common-triple-compound-score)

### Listen for

Both clips play six Cs at the same intervals. Tap on notes 1, 3, and 5 in A and on notes 1 and 4 in B. Listen for three main beats in A and two in B.

Each clip repeats the same bar. Listen once, then tap only the main beats in the second bar.


ja.title: 拍子
ja.summary: 拍のまとまりの中で強い位置と弱い位置が繰り返される仕組み
ja.description:
拍子は拍を繰り返すまとまりに分ける仕組みである。4/4では通常、四分音符の長さの拍を四つずつ一小節にする。6/8では八分音符三つ分の大きな拍を二つ感じるのが一般的である。 同じ八分音符六つでも、3/4では2+2+2、6/8では通常3+3にまとめる。

![Aは3/4で8分音符6個を2+2+2に、Bは6/8で3+3にまとめた楽譜](asset:music-common-triple-compound-score)

cards.title: 마디와 세로줄
cards.description:
마디는 박자에 따라 박을 묶은 단위이고, 세로줄은 악보에서 마디 사이의 경계를 나타낸다. 4/4의 온전한 한 마디에는 4분음표 네 박만큼의 음과 쉼이 들어간다. 세로줄 자체는 쉬라는 표시가 아니다.

### 들어 보기

같은 간격의 음이다. A는 네 박마다, B는 두 박마다 첫 박이 온다. 강한 소리 직전에 세로줄이 있다고 생각하고 이어 세어 보자.

```piano
{"label":"A · 네 박씩 묶기","duration":3.54,"notes":[[67,0,0.292,104],[67,0.43,0.292,65],[67,0.86,0.292,72],[67,1.29,0.292,65],[67,1.72,0.292,104],[67,2.15,0.292,65],[67,2.58,0.292,72],[67,3.01,0.292,65]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 두 박씩 묶기","duration":3.54,"notes":[[67,0,0.292,104],[67,0.43,0.292,65],[67,0.86,0.292,104],[67,1.29,0.292,65],[67,1.72,0.292,104],[67,2.15,0.292,65],[67,2.58,0.292,104],[67,3.01,0.292,65]]}
```

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

en-US.title: Measure and barline
en-US.description:
A measure groups beats according to the meter, and a barline marks the boundary between measures. A full measure of 4/4 contains four quarter-note beats’ worth of notes and rests. The barline itself calls for no pause.

### Listen for

The notes are evenly spaced. In A, count in fours. In B, count in twos. Imagine a barline just before each strong beat and keep counting through it.

ja.title: 小節と小節線
ja.description:

cards.title: 못갖춘마디
cards.description:
못갖춘마디는 곡이 첫 강박 전에 시작해 맨 처음 마디가 박자에 필요한 길이보다 짧은 경우다. 4/4에서 4분음표 하나만 앞에 나오면 그 음을 넷째 박으로 세고 다음 마디의 첫 음을 하나로 센다.

### 들어 보기

A는 높은 C에서 바로 시작한다. B에서는 낮은 G를 ‘넷’으로 세고, 같은 높은 C에서 두 예시 모두 ‘하나’를 느껴 보자.

```piano
{"label":"A · 첫 박에서 시작","duration":3.7,"notes":[[72,0.43,0.31,102],[74,0.86,0.31,68],[76,1.29,0.31,75],[77,1.72,0.31,68],[76,2.15,0.31,101],[74,2.58,0.31,68],[72,3.01,0.55,73]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 넷째 박에서 시작","duration":3.7,"notes":[[67,0,0.32,62],[72,0.43,0.31,102],[74,0.86,0.31,68],[76,1.29,0.31,75],[77,1.72,0.31,68],[76,2.15,0.31,101],[74,2.58,0.31,68],[72,3.01,0.55,73]]}
```

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

en-US.title: Pickup measure
en-US.description:
A pickup measure is a shortened opening measure whose notes lead into the first downbeat. A single quarter-note pickup in 4/4 takes beat four. Count the first beat of the next measure as one.

### Listen for

A starts right on the high C. In B, count the low G as four. Hear the same high C as beat one in both versions.

```piano
{"label":"A · Start on beat one","duration":3.7,"notes":[[72,0.43,0.31,102],[74,0.86,0.31,68],[76,1.29,0.31,75],[77,1.72,0.31,68],[76,2.15,0.31,101],[74,2.58,0.31,68],[72,3.01,0.55,73]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · Start on beat four","duration":3.7,"notes":[[67,0,0.32,62],[72,0.43,0.31,102],[74,0.86,0.31,68],[76,1.29,0.31,75],[77,1.72,0.31,68],[76,2.15,0.31,101],[74,2.58,0.31,68],[72,3.01,0.55,73]]}
```

### References

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

ja.title: 弱起（アウフタクト）
ja.description:
弱起では最初の強拍より先に曲が始まり、冒頭の小節が所定の拍数より短くなる。4/4拍子で四分音符一つの弱起なら、その音を四拍目、次の小節頭を一拍目と数える。

### 聴くポイント

Aは高いCで始まる。Bはその前の低いGを「四」と数え、どちらも高いCで「一」を感じよう。

```piano
{"label":"A · 一拍目から開始","duration":3.7,"notes":[[72,0.43,0.31,102],[74,0.86,0.31,68],[76,1.29,0.31,75],[77,1.72,0.31,68],[76,2.15,0.31,101],[74,2.58,0.31,68],[72,3.01,0.55,73]]}
```

```piano

```

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

zh-TW.description:

### 聆聽重點

A 直接從較高的 C 開始。B 先把較低的 G 數作四，再聽出兩段都在較高的 C 進入第一拍。

cards.title: 4분음표의 박
cards.description:
4/4박자에서 4분음표 네 개가 한 마디를 채웁니다. 이 예시에서는 4분음표를 한 박으로 셉니다.

### 악보 예시

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C C C C |
```

### 박과 소리 연결하기

먼저 일정하게 “하나, 둘, 셋, 넷”을 세면 각 숫자에서 새 음이 시작한다. 이 악보의 4분음표=96은 1분에 96박이라는 뜻이므로 한 박은 60÷96=0.625초, 네 박의 한 마디는 2.5초다. 여기서는 음의 시작과 박이 일치하지만 모든 리듬이 그런 것은 아니다. 다음 8분음표 예와 같은 박을 유지하며 비교하면 박과 음표 수의 차이가 드러난다.

### 들어 보기

같은 높이의 음으로 길이에만 집중하세요. 속도를 바꾸어도 길이의 비율은 유지됩니다.

서양 기보법·12평균율의 학습용 합성음 예시입니다. 실제 연주의 음색·강약을 재현하지 않습니다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

en-US.title: Quarter-note pulse
en-US.description:
In 4/4, four quarter notes fill a measure. Here the quarter note is the beat unit.

### Score example

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C C C C |
```

### Connecting pulse and sound

Count an even “one, two, three, four”: a new tone begins on each number. The score’s quarter-note tempo of 96 means 96 beats per minute, so each beat lasts 60÷96=0.625 seconds and this four-beat measure lasts 2.5 seconds. Attacks coincide with beats here, but that is not true of every rhythm. Keep the same pulse when comparing the eighth-note example to distinguish the number of notes from the number of beats.

### Listen for

Focus on duration: all tones use the same pitch. Changing speed preserves the duration ratios.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.

### References

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)
en-US.summary: A note duration counted as one beat in 4/4 meter

ja.title: 4分音符の拍
ja.description:
4/4拍子では4分音符4つで1小節になります。この例は4分音符を1拍と数えます。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C C C C |
```

### 拍と音を結びつける

一定に「1、2、3、4」と数えると、各数字で新しい音が始まる。この譜面の4分音符=96は毎分96拍なので、1拍は60÷96=0.625秒、4拍の小節は2.5秒になる。ここでは発音と拍が一致するが、すべてのリズムがそうではない。8分音符の例と同じ拍を保って比べると、音符数と拍数の違いが分かる。

### 聴くポイント

同じ高さの音で長さに集中しましょう。速度を変えても長さの比率は保たれます。

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)
ja.summary: 4/4拍子で一つを一拍として数える音符の長さ

zh-TW.title: 四分音符拍點
zh-TW.description:
在4/4拍中，四個四分音符構成一小節。本例以四分音符為一拍。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C C C C |
```

### 連結拍點與聲音

均勻數「一、二、三、四」，每個數字都有新音開始。譜上四分音符=96表示每分鐘96拍，因此每拍60÷96=0.625秒，四拍一小節為2.5秒。這裡起音與拍點一致，但不是所有節奏都如此。與八分音符範例比較時保持相同拍速，便能區分音符數與拍數。

### 聆聽重點

所有音使用相同音高，請專注於時值。改變速度不會改變時值比例。

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)
zh-TW.summary: 在4/4拍中一個計為一拍的音符時值

cards.title: 8분음표의 분할
cards.description:
한 박을 같은 길이의 두 부분으로 나눕니다. 음표 수가 늘어도 한 마디의 길이는 앞 카드와 같습니다.

### 악보 예시

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
CC CC CC CC |
```

### 박과 소리 연결하기

박을 네 번 짚으면서 그 사이를 하나씩 더 나누면 한 박에 두 음, 한 마디에 여덟 음이 된다. 4분음표=96은 그대로이므로 한 마디는 여전히 2.5초이고 각 8분음표의 기보상 길이는 0.3125초다. 음이 더 자주 시작된다고 기본 박까지 두 배 빨라진 것은 아니다. 큰 박을 유지한 채 그 안의 균등한 두 부분을 듣는 것이 비교의 핵심이다.

### 들어 보기

같은 높이의 음으로 길이에만 집중하세요. 속도를 바꾸어도 길이의 비율은 유지됩니다.

서양 기보법·12평균율의 학습용 합성음 예시입니다. 실제 연주의 음색·강약을 재현하지 않습니다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

en-US.title: Eighth-note subdivision
en-US.description:
Each beat divides into two equal parts. More notes do not make the measure longer than the quarter-note example.

### Score example

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
CC CC CC CC |
```

### Connecting pulse and sound

Keep four steady beats and divide each into two equal parts. There are now eight notes in the measure, but the quarter-note tempo remains 96, so the measure still lasts 2.5 seconds and each notated eighth lasts 0.3125 seconds. More frequent attacks do not mean the underlying beat has doubled in speed. Listen to the larger pulse while locating both equal subdivisions inside it, rather than counting every note as a new main beat.

### Listen for

Focus on duration: all tones use the same pitch. Changing speed preserves the duration ratios.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.

### References

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)
en-US.summary: A subdivision into two equal parts per beat in the 4/4 example

ja.title: 8分音符への分割
ja.description:
1拍を等しい2つに分けます。音符が増えても4分音符の例と小節の長さは同じです。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
CC CC CC CC |
```

### 拍と音を結びつける

四つの拍を保ち、それぞれを等しく二分すると、一小節に八つの音が入る。4分音符=96は変わらないので、小節は2.5秒のままで、8分音符の記譜上の長さは0.3125秒である。発音回数が増えても基本の拍が倍速になったわけではない。すべての音を主拍に数え直さず、大きな拍の中に二つの均等な部分を聴き取る。

### 聴くポイント

同じ高さの音で長さに集中しましょう。速度を変えても長さの比率は保たれます。

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)
ja.summary: 4/4拍子の例で一拍を等しい二つに分けるリズム

zh-TW.title: 八分音符細分
zh-TW.description:
每拍平均分成兩份。音符雖然增加，小節長度仍與四分音符範例相同。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
CC CC CC CC |
```

### 連結拍點與聲音

保持四個穩定拍點，每拍等分成兩份，小節裡就有八個音。四分音符=96不變，因此一小節仍是2.5秒，每個八分音符的記譜時值為0.3125秒。起音變頻繁不代表基本拍速加倍。應聽著較大的拍子，再找出裡面的兩個等分，不把每個音都改數成主拍。

### 聆聽重點

所有音使用相同音高，請專注於時值。改變速度不會改變時值比例。

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

cards.title: 3/4박자의 세 박
cards.description:
3/4박자는 한 마디에 4분음표 세 박이 있고 각 박을 8분음표 둘로 나누는 단순 3박자다. 6/8박자의 8분음표 여섯 개는 보통 세 개씩 두 큰 박으로 묶인다.

![A는 3/4로 8분음표 여섯 개가 2+2+2, B는 6/8로 3+3으로 묶인 악보](asset:music-common-triple-compound-score)

### 들어 보기

두 예시의 음 사이 간격은 같습니다. A의 큰 박은 2개씩 묶은 음의 처음 세 곳, B의 큰 박은 3개씩 묶은 음의 처음 두 곳입니다. 쉼 없이 소리만 들어도 큰 박이 바뀌는지 확인해 보세요.

각 예시는 같은 마디를 두 번 들려줍니다. 첫 마디를 들은 뒤 다음 마디에서 큰 박만 손으로 짚어 보세요.

```piano

```

```piano
{"label":"B · 6/8 · 3+3","duration":3.334,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,104],[60,0.278,0.21,55],[60,0.556,0.21,55],[60,0.833,0.21,86],[60,1.111,0.21,55],[60,1.389,0.21,55],[60,1.667,0.21,104],[60,1.945,0.21,55],[60,2.223,0.21,55],[60,2.5,0.21,86],[60,2.778,0.21,55],[60,3.056,0.21,55]]}
```

### 출처

en-US.title: Three beats in 3/4
en-US.description:
3/4 is a simple triple meter with three quarter-note beats per measure, each divided into two eighth notes. In 6/8, the six eighth notes normally form two main beats of three notes each.

![Score A beams six eighth notes as 2+2+2 in 3/4. Score B beams them as 3+3 in 6/8.](asset:music-common-triple-compound-score)

### Listen for

The eighth notes move at the same rate. Count A as “one-and, two-and, three-and” and B as “one-two-three, one-two-three.”

Each clip repeats the same bar. Listen once, then tap only the main beats in the second bar.

```piano
{"label":"A · 3/4 · 2+2+2","duration":3.334,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,104],[60,0.278,0.21,55],[60,0.556,0.21,86],[60,0.833,0.21,55],[60,1.111,0.21,86],[60,1.389,0.21,55],[60,1.667,0.21,104],[60,1.945,0.21,55],[60,2.223,0.21,86],[60,2.5,0.21,55],[60,2.778,0.21,86],[60,3.056,0.21,55]]}
```

ja.title: 3/4拍子の三拍
ja.description:
3/4拍子は、一小節に四分音符三拍があり、各拍を八分音符二つに分ける単純三拍子である。6/8拍子では通常、六つの八分音符が三つずつ二つの大きな拍にまとまる。

![Aは3/4で8分音符6個を2+2+2に、Bは6/8で3+3にまとめた楽譜](asset:music-common-triple-compound-score)

### 聴くポイント

八分音符の速さは同じ。Aでは二つずつ三組、Bでは三つずつ二組に分け、組の頭の強い音を数えよう。

どちらも同じ小節を2回繰り返します。1小節目を聴き、2小節目で大きな拍だけを手で刻みましょう。

```piano
{"label":"A · 3/4 · 2+2+2","duration":3.334,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,104],[60,0.278,0.21,55],[60,0.556,0.21,86],[60,0.833,0.21,55],[60,1.111,0.21,86],[60,1.389,0.21,55],[60,1.667,0.21,104],[60,1.945,0.21,55],[60,2.223,0.21,86],[60,2.5,0.21,55],[60,2.778,0.21,86],[60,3.056,0.21,55]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 6/8 · 3+3","duration":3.334,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,104],[60,0.278,0.21,55],[60,0.556,0.21,55],[60,0.833,0.21,86],[60,1.111,0.21,55],[60,1.389,0.21,55],[60,1.667,0.21,104],[60,1.945,0.21,55],[60,2.223,0.21,55],[60,2.5,0.21,86],[60,2.778,0.21,55],[60,3.056,0.21,55]]}
```

zh-TW.title: 3/4 拍的三拍
zh-TW.description:
3/4 拍是單三拍子，每小節有三個四分音符拍，每拍可分成兩個八分音符。6/8 拍的六個八分音符通常是三個一組，共兩個主拍。

![A 是 3/4，六個八分音符連成 2+2+2。B 是 6/8，連成 3+3。](asset:music-common-triple-compound-score)

### 聆聽重點

八分音符的速度相同。A 兩個一組、共三組，B 三個一組、共兩組。跟著每組開頭較強的一音數拍。

每段都重複同一小節兩次。先聽第一小節，再用手打出第二小節的大拍。

```piano
{"label":"A · 3/4 · 2+2+2","duration":3.334,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,104],[60,0.278,0.21,55],[60,0.556,0.21,86],[60,0.833,0.21,55],[60,1.111,0.21,86],[60,1.389,0.21,55],[60,1.667,0.21,104],[60,1.945,0.21,55],[60,2.223,0.21,86],[60,2.5,0.21,55],[60,2.778,0.21,86],[60,3.056,0.21,55]]}
```

cards.title: 16분음표의 분할
cards.description:
한 박을 같은 길이의 네 부분으로 나눕니다. 느리게 듣기로 박과 세부 분할을 구별하세요.

### 악보 예시

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/16
Q:1/4=96
K:C
CCCC CCCC CCCC CCCC |
```

### 박과 소리 연결하기

한 박 안을 네 번 균등하게 나누므로 네 박의 마디에는 16개 음이 들어간다. 4분음표=96에서 기보상 한 음의 길이는 0.625÷4=0.15625초지만 마디 전체는 앞 예들과 같은 2.5초다. 재생을 느리게 해도 한 박에 네 부분이라는 관계는 유지된다. 음 하나하나를 따라가다 큰 박을 놓친다면 먼저 박만 짚은 뒤 그 안의 네 위치를 연결해 보자.

### 들어 보기

같은 높이의 음으로 길이에만 집중하세요. 속도를 바꾸어도 길이의 비율은 유지됩니다.

서양 기보법·12평균율의 학습용 합성음 예시입니다. 실제 연주의 음색·강약을 재현하지 않습니다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

en-US.title: Sixteenth-note subdivision
en-US.description:
Each beat divides into four equal parts. Use slow playback to distinguish the pulse from its subdivisions.

### Score example

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/16
Q:1/4=96
K:C
CCCC CCCC CCCC CCCC |
```

### Connecting pulse and sound

Four equal subdivisions per beat put sixteen notes into the four-beat measure. At quarter-note 96, the notated duration of each is 0.625÷4=0.15625 seconds, while the full measure remains 2.5 seconds like the earlier examples. Slower playback changes elapsed time but preserves four subdivisions per beat. If following every attack hides the larger pulse, first mark only that pulse and then locate the four evenly spaced positions within each beat.

### Listen for

Focus on duration: all tones use the same pitch. Changing speed preserves the duration ratios.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.

### References

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)
en-US.summary: A subdivision into four equal parts per beat in the 4/4 example

ja.title: 16分音符への分割
ja.description:
1拍を等しい4つに分けます。遅い再生で拍と細かな分割を区別しましょう。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/16
Q:1/4=96
K:C
CCCC CCCC CCCC CCCC |
```

### 拍と音を結びつける

一拍を四等分するので、四拍の小節に16音が入る。4分音符=96では各音の記譜上の長さは0.625÷4=0.15625秒で、小節全体は前の例と同じ2.5秒である。再生を遅くしても一拍を四分する関係は保たれる。細かい発音を追って大きな拍を失うなら、まず拍だけを取り、その中の均等な四つの位置を確かめる。

### 聴くポイント

同じ高さの音で長さに集中しましょう。速度を変えても長さの比率は保たれます。

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)
ja.summary: 4/4拍子の例で一拍を等しい四つに分けるリズム

zh-TW.title: 十六分音符細分
zh-TW.description:
每拍平均分成四份。可用慢速播放分辨拍點與細分音。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/16
Q:1/4=96
K:C
CCCC CCCC CCCC CCCC |
```

### 連結拍點與聲音

每拍四等分，四拍小節便有16個音。四分音符=96時，每音記譜時值為0.625÷4=0.15625秒，但整小節仍與前例相同，是2.5秒。慢速播放會改變實際時間，卻保留每拍四等分。若跟著每次起音反而失去大拍，可先只打主拍，再找出每拍內四個均勻位置。

### 聆聽重點

所有音使用相同音高，請專注於時值。改變速度不會改變時值比例。

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

cards.title: 쉼표
cards.description:
쉼표도 시간을 차지합니다. 소리가 없는 두 번째와 네 번째 박에서도 일정한 박을 유지하세요.

### 악보 예시

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C z C z |
```

### 박과 소리 연결하기

소리는 첫째·셋째 박에만 나지만 “하나, 둘, 셋, 넷”의 시간은 모두 지나간다. 쉼표가 있는 둘째·넷째 박을 건너뛰고 바로 다음 소리로 붙이면 네 박의 악보를 두 박처럼 바꿔 버린다. 이 예에서 쉼표 하나도 4분음표와 같은 한 박을 차지한다. 소리가 없는 동안에도 같은 속도로 박을 세어야 다음 음이 정해진 위치에 시작한다.

### 들어 보기

같은 높이의 음으로 길이에만 집중하세요. 속도를 바꾸어도 길이의 비율은 유지됩니다.

서양 기보법·12평균율의 학습용 합성음 예시입니다. 실제 연주의 음색·강약을 재현하지 않습니다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

소리는 첫째·셋째 박에만 나지만 “하나, 둘, 셋, 넷”의 시간은 모두 지나간다. 쉼표가 있는 둘째·넷째 박을 건너뛰고 바로 다음 소리로 붙이면 네 박의 악보를 두 박처럼 바꿔 버린다. 이 예에서 쉼표 하나도 4분음표와 같은 한 박을 차지한다. 소리가 없는 동안에도 같은 속도로 박을 세어야 다음 음이 정해진 위치에 시작한다.

### 들어 보기

같은 높이의 음으로 길이에만 집중하세요. 속도를 바꾸어도 길이의 비율은 유지됩니다.

en-US.title: Rests
en-US.description:
Rests occupy time. Keep the pulse through the silent second and fourth beats.

### Score example

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C z C z |
```

### Connecting pulse and sound

Tones occur only on beats one and three, but all four counts still take time. Skipping the silent second and fourth beats would compress the written four-beat measure into something like two beats. Each rest here occupies the same notated duration as a quarter note. Continue the pulse during silence so the next attack arrives at its written position. Silence is part of the rhythmic pattern, not an instruction to pause the musical clock until another sound occurs.

### Listen for

Focus on duration: all tones use the same pitch. Changing speed preserves the duration ratios.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

ja.title: 休符
ja.description:
休符にも長さがあります。音のない第2拍と第4拍でも拍を保ちましょう。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C z C z |
```

### 拍と音を結びつける

音が出るのは第1拍と第3拍だけだが、「1、2、3、4」の時間はすべて進む。無音の第2拍と第4拍を飛ばすと、四拍の譜面を二拍のように縮めてしまう。この休符も4分音符と同じ一拍を占める。無音の間も拍を保つことで次の発音が指定の位置に来る。休符は音楽の時計を止める指示ではなく、リズムの一部である。

### 聴くポイント

同じ高さの音で長さに集中しましょう。速度を変えても長さの比率は保たれます。

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)
ja.summary: 音を鳴らさず、指定された長さだけ時間を保つ記号

zh-TW.title: 休止符
zh-TW.description:
休止符也占有時間。第二與第四拍雖無聲，仍要保持穩定拍點。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C z C z |
```

### 連結拍點與聲音

聲音只在第一、第三拍出現，但「一、二、三、四」的時間仍全部經過。若跳過無聲的第二、第四拍，就把四拍譜例壓成近似兩拍。此處每個休止符與四分音符一樣占一拍。無聲時仍維持拍速，下一次起音才能落在記譜位置；休止是節奏的一部分，不是暫停音樂時計。

### 聆聽重點

所有音使用相同音高，請專注於時值。改變速度不會改變時值比例。

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

cards.title: 점음표 리듬
cards.description:
점4분음표와 8분음표는 길이가 3:1입니다. 두 음을 합치면 2박이며, 점은 원래 길이의 절반을 더합니다.

### 악보 예시

```abc
L:1/4

K:C
C>C C>C |
```

### 들어 보기

en-US.title: Dotted rhythm
en-US.description:
A dotted quarter followed by an eighth has a 3:1 duration ratio and spans two beats. A dot adds half the original duration.

### Score example

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C>C C>C |
```

### Connecting pulse and sound

A dot adds half of a quarter note’s one beat, making the dotted quarter 1.5 beats. The following eighth supplies 0.5, so the pair spans two beats; repeating the pair fills this four-beat measure. Two plain quarters would divide the same space 1:1, whereas this pair divides it 3:1. Notice that the second attack arrives half a beat after beat two begins. Counting that location connects the written dot with the heard long-short pattern.

### Listen for

Focus on duration: all tones use the same pitch. Changing speed preserves the duration ratios.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.

### References

[Open Music Theory · Other Rhythmic Essentials](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-rhythmic-essentials/)
en-US.summary: A mark adding half of a note’s original duration, making it one and a half times as long

ja.title: 付点リズム
ja.description:
付点4分音符と8分音符の長さは3対1です。合わせて2拍で、付点は元の長さの半分を加えます。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C>C C>C |
```

### 拍と音を結びつける

4分音符の一拍にその半分を加えると、付点4分音符は1.5拍になる。続く8分音符0.5拍と合わせて二拍で、その組が二回あるため四拍を満たす。同じ二拍でも普通の4分音符二つなら1対1、ここでは3対1である。二つ目の発音が第2拍の開始より半拍遅いことを数えると、付点と長短の響きが結びつく。

### 聴くポイント

同じ高さの音で長さに集中しましょう。速度を変えても長さの比率は保たれます。

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Rhythmic Essentials](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-rhythmic-essentials/)

zh-TW.title: 附點節奏
zh-TW.description:
附點四分音符與八分音符的時值比為3:1，合計兩拍。附點增加原時值的一半。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C>C C>C |
```

### 連結拍點與聲音

四分音符一拍加上自身的一半，附點四分音符便是1.5拍。接著的八分音符0.5拍補足兩拍，這組重複兩次填滿四拍。相同兩拍若用兩個四分音符分配是1:1，此處則是3:1。留意第二音在第二拍開始後半拍才起音，就能把附點記號連到長短節奏。

### 聆聽重點

所有音使用相同音高，請專注於時值。改變速度不會改變時值比例。

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Other Rhythmic Essentials](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-rhythmic-essentials/)

cards.title: 셋잇단음표
cards.description:
보통 8분음표 두 개가 들어갈 한 박에 세 개를 균등하게 넣습니다. 빠르게 세 음을 치는 것만으로는 셋잇단음표가 되지 않습니다.

en-US.title: Triplets
en-US.description:
Three equal eighth-note triplets fit into the beat normally occupied by two eighth notes. Merely playing three quick notes does not define a triplet.

### Score example

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
(3CCC (3CCC (3CCC (3CCC |
```

### Connecting pulse and sound

Three equal triplet notes occupy the beat that normally holds two eighth notes. Each therefore takes one third of a beat; four groups give twelve notes across this four-beat measure. Keep the same quarter-note pulse as in the ordinary eighth-note example to compare dividing into two with dividing into three. The defining feature is three equal parts within that specified duration, not simply a sequence of three notes played quickly at an unspecified speed.

### Listen for

Focus on duration: all tones use the same pitch. Changing speed preserves the duration ratios.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.

### References

[Open Music Theory · Other Rhythmic Essentials](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-rhythmic-essentials/)
en-US.summary: In this score, three equal notes occupy the beat normally filled by two eighth notes

ja.title: 3連符
ja.description:
通常8分音符2つが入る1拍に、3つを均等に入れます。単に3音を速く弾くだけでは3連符になりません。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
(3CCC (3CCC (3CCC (3CCC |
```

### 拍と音を結びつける

普通なら8分音符二つが入る一拍に、等しい長さの三連符三つが入る。各音は一拍の3分の1で、四組・計12音が四拍を満たす。普通の8分音符の例と同じ4分音符の拍を保つと、二分と三分を比較できる。速さを決めず三音を素早く弾くことではなく、指定された時間を均等に三分することが重要である。

### 聴くポイント

同じ高さの音で長さに集中しましょう。速度を変えても長さの比率は保たれます。

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Rhythmic Essentials](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-rhythmic-essentials/)
ja.summary: この譜例で通常八分音符二つが入る一拍を、等しい三つに分けるリズム

zh-TW.title: 三連音
zh-TW.description:
通常容納兩個八分音符的一拍，改為平均放入三個音。只把三音彈快並不等於三連音。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
(3CCC (3CCC (3CCC (3CCC |
```

### 連結拍點與聲音

通常容納兩個八分音符的一拍，改放三個等長三連音，因此每音占一拍的三分之一；四組共12音填滿四拍。保持與一般八分音符例相同的四分音符拍速，才能比較二等分與三等分。重點是把指定時間均分成三份，不是以不明速度快速演奏任意三音。

### 聆聽重點

所有音使用相同音高，請專注於時值。改變速度不會改變時值比例。

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Other Rhythmic Essentials](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-rhythmic-essentials/)
zh-TW.summary: 此譜例把通常容納兩個八分音符的一拍均分為三份的節奏

cards.title: 박자 강세
cards.summary: 박의 묶음 안에서 특정 위치가 주변보다 강하게 기대되는 성질
cards.description:
박자 강세는 박이 반복해서 묶일 때 특정 위치가 더 중요하게 느껴지는 성질이다. 4/4에서는 첫 박이 보통 가장 강하게 기대된다.

![박자 강세 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-metric-accent-score)

### 들어 보기

두 예 모두 같은 도를 같은 속도로 여덟 번 칩니다. 네 박씩 두 마디를 세면서 A에서는 매번 첫 박에, B에서는 매번 둘째 박에 들리는 강조를 따라가 보세요. 둘째 박을 더 세게 쳐도 지금 세고 있는 첫 박의 위치는 그대로입니다.

```piano
{"label":"A · 첫 박 강조","duration":5.0,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,106],[60,0.625,0.56,55],[60,1.25,0.56,55],[60,1.875,0.56,55],[60,2.5,0.56,106],[60,3.125,0.56,55],[60,3.75,0.56,55],[60,4.375,0.56,55]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 둘째 박 강조","duration":5.0,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,55],[60,0.625,0.56,106],[60,1.25,0.56,55],[60,1.875,0.56,55],[60,2.5,0.56,55],[60,3.125,0.56,106],[60,3.75,0.56,55],[60,4.375,0.56,55]]}
```

### 구별할 점

강한 박마다 소리를 크게 연주해야 한다는 지시는 아니다. 첫 박에 쉼표가 있어도 그 박의 위치를 셀 수 있다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

en-US.title: Metrical accent
en-US.summary: The relative weight expected at certain positions in a group of beats
en-US.description:
Metrical accent is the relative weight listeners expect at certain positions in a repeating group of beats. The first beat of a 4/4 measure normally has the strongest metrical weight.

![Metrical accent · Example score](asset:music-common-metric-accent-score)

### Listen for

Both clips repeat C eight times at the same speed. Count two measures of four. A brings out beat one each time, while B brings out beat two. Keep counting from the same place in B and feel how the played accent falls away from the expected strong beat.

```piano
{"label":"A · Beat one emphasized","duration":5.0,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,106],[60,0.625,0.56,55],[60,1.25,0.56,55],[60,1.875,0.56,55],[60,2.5,0.56,106],[60,3.125,0.56,55],[60,3.75,0.56,55],[60,4.375,0.56,55]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · Beat two emphasized","duration":5.0,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,55],[60,0.625,0.56,106],[60,1.25,0.56,55],[60,1.875,0.56,55],[60,2.5,0.56,55],[60,3.125,0.56,106],[60,3.75,0.56,55],[60,4.375,0.56,55]]}
```

### Distinguish

A metrically strong beat need not be louder. It can still be counted if it contains a rest.

### Sources

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

ja.title: 拍節上の強勢
ja.summary: 拍のまとまりの中で特定の位置が強く感じられる性質
ja.description:
拍節上の強勢は、拍が繰り返しまとまるときに特定の位置が相対的に強く感じられる性質である。4/4では通常、第1拍に最も強い重みを感じる。

![拍節上の強勢 · 譜例](asset:music-common-metric-accent-score)

### 聴くポイント

どちらも同じ高さのドが同じ速さで8回鳴ります。四拍ずつ二小節を数えながら、Aでは第1拍、Bでは第2拍の強調を聴きましょう。Bでも数え始める位置を保つと、強調が本来強いと感じる拍からずれて聞こえます。

```piano
{"label":"A · 第1拍を強調","duration":5.0,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,106],[60,0.625,0.56,55],[60,1.25,0.56,55],[60,1.875,0.56,55],[60,2.5,0.56,106],[60,3.125,0.56,55],[60,3.75,0.56,55],[60,4.375,0.56,55]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 第2拍を強調","duration":5.0,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,55],[60,0.625,0.56,106],[60,1.25,0.56,55],[60,1.875,0.56,55],[60,2.5,0.56,55],[60,3.125,0.56,106],[60,3.75,0.56,55],[60,4.375,0.56,55]]}
```

### 見分け方

強い拍を必ず大きな音で演奏する必要はない。休符があっても第1拍の位置を数えられる。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

zh-TW.title: 拍節重音
zh-TW.summary: 一組拍點中相對較有重量的預期位置
zh-TW.description:
拍節重音是拍點反覆組合時，某些位置預期有較強的重量感。4/4 拍中，第一拍通常有最強的拍節重量。

![拍節重音 · 譜例](asset:music-common-metric-accent-score)

### 聆聽重點

兩段都以相同速度奏八個同音高的 C。每四拍數成一小節，聽 A 如何突出每小節第一拍，B 如何突出第二拍。聽 B 時從同一個位置開始數，感受實際的重音落在預期強拍之外。

```piano
{"label":"A · 突出第一拍","duration":5.0,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,106],[60,0.625,0.56,55],[60,1.25,0.56,55],[60,1.875,0.56,55],[60,2.5,0.56,106],[60,3.125,0.56,55],[60,3.75,0.56,55],[60,4.375,0.56,55]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 突出第二拍","duration":5.0,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,55],[60,0.625,0.56,106],[60,1.25,0.56,55],[60,1.875,0.56,55],[60,2.5,0.56,55],[60,3.125,0.56,106],[60,3.75,0.56,55],[60,4.375,0.56,55]]}
```

### 辨別重點

強拍不一定要奏得比較大聲。第一拍即使是休止符，也可以數出這個位置。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Simple Meter and Time Signatures](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/simple-meter-and-time-signatures/)

cards.title: 당김음
cards.description:
약한 위치에서 시작한 음을 다음 박까지 붙임줄로 이어 봅니다. 소리가 시작되는 위치와 일정한 박이 어긋나는 느낌을 들어 보세요. 붙임줄 외에도 강한 위치의 쉼표나 약한 위치의 강조로 당김음이 생길 수 있다.

### 악보 예시

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
z C- C2 C C C2 |
```

### 박과 소리 연결하기

첫 박의 앞 절반은 쉬고 뒤 절반에서 음이 시작한다. 붙임줄은 그 음을 둘째 박까지 이어 주므로 둘째 박 시작에 다시 치지 않는다. 따라서 일정한 박은 계속되지만 새 음이 시작하는 위치는 박과 어긋난다. 소리를 한 번 더 넣어 붙임줄을 무시하면 이 관계가 달라진다. 합성음의 강약보다 박을 짚으면서 음의 시작과 지속을 구분해 들어 보자.

### 들어 보기

같은 높이의 음으로 길이에만 집중하세요. 속도를 바꾸어도 길이의 비율은 유지됩니다.

서양 기보법·12평균율의 학습용 합성음 예시입니다. 실제 연주의 음색·강약을 재현하지 않습니다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Rhythmic Essentials](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-rhythmic-essentials/)

en-US.title: Syncopation
en-US.description:
A note beginning on a weak subdivision is tied across the next beat. Hear how the attacks shift away from the steady pulse. Syncopation can also come from a rest in a strong position or emphasis in a weak position.

### Score example

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
z C- C2 C C C2 |
```

### Connecting pulse and sound

The first half of beat one is silent, and the tone begins on its second half. The tie carries that tone through beat two, so there is no new attack at the start of beat two. A steady pulse continues underneath while the attack pattern falls away from it. Reattacking the tied note would change that relationship. Focus on where a tone starts and where it merely continues, rather than expecting the synthesized example to reproduce a performer’s dynamic accents.

### Listen for

Focus on duration: all tones use the same pitch. Changing speed preserves the duration ratios.

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.

### References

[Open Music Theory · Other Rhythmic Essentials](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-rhythmic-essentials/)
en-US.summary: A rhythm whose onsets or continuations in weak positions depart from the underlying beat pattern

ja.title: シンコペーション
ja.description:
弱い位置から始まる音をタイで次の拍へつなぎます。音の始まりが一定の拍からずれる感覚を聴きましょう。 強い位置を休符にしたり、弱い位置を強調したりしてもシンコペーションは生じる。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
z C- C2 C C C2 |
```

### 拍と音を結びつける

第1拍の前半は休み、後半から音が始まる。タイでその音が第2拍へ続くので、第2拍の頭で弾き直さない。一定の拍は進む一方、新しい発音の位置が拍からずれる。タイを無視して弾き直すと関係が変わる。合成音が演奏者の強弱を再現することを期待するより、音が始まる場所と続いている場所を拍に合わせて聴き分ける。

### 聴くポイント

同じ高さの音で長さに集中しましょう。速度を変えても長さの比率は保たれます。

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Rhythmic Essentials](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-rhythmic-essentials/)
ja.summary: 弱い位置の発音や持続を基本の拍からずらすリズム

zh-TW.title: 切分音
zh-TW.description:
從弱細分位置開始的音以延音線跨越下一拍。聆聽起音與穩定拍點錯開的感受。 強位置留休止，或在弱位置加強，也能形成切分。

### 譜例

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
Q:1/4=96
K:C
z C- C2 C C C2 |
```

### 連結拍點與聲音

第一拍前半休息，後半才起音；連結線讓此音持續到第二拍，因此第二拍開頭不重新發音。穩定拍子仍繼續，起音位置卻與它錯開。忽略連結線重新敲一次，便改變這項關係。應邊打拍邊分辨音的開始與延續，而非期待合成音重現演奏者的力度重音。

### 聆聽重點

所有音使用相同音高，請專注於時值。改變速度不會改變時值比例。

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Other Rhythmic Essentials](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-rhythmic-essentials/)
zh-TW.summary: 讓弱位置的起音或延續與基本拍點錯開的節奏

cards.title: 6/8박자의 두 큰 박
cards.description:
보통 점4분음표를 큰 한 박으로 세고 각 박을 8분음표 세 개로 나눕니다. 여섯 음이 있다고 항상 여섯 개의 큰 박은 아닙니다.

![A는 3/4로 8분음표 여섯 개가 2+2+2, B는 6/8로 3+3으로 묶인 악보](asset:music-common-triple-compound-score)

### 박과 소리 연결하기

여섯 개의 8분음표를 “하나-둘-셋, 하나-둘-셋” 두 묶음으로 느끼면 각 묶음이 점4분음표 한 박이다. 예시 B의 빠르기는 점4분음표=72이므로 큰 박은 분당 72번, 한 마디에는 큰 박 두 번이 들어간다. 3/4에서도 8분음표 여섯 개가 들어갈 수 있지만 보통 두 개씩 세 박으로 묶인다. 음표 수만 같다고 박의 조직까지 같은 것은 아니다. 박을 느끼는 방식에는 빠르기와 음악적 맥락도 영향을 준다.

### 들어 보기

en-US.title: Two main beats in 6/8
en-US.description:
Usually count two dotted-quarter beats, each divided into three eighth notes. Six notes do not necessarily mean six main beats.

![Score A beams six eighth notes as 2+2+2 in 3/4. Score B beams them as 3+3 in 6/8.](asset:music-common-triple-compound-score)

### Connecting pulse and sound

Group the six eighth notes as “one-two-three, one-two-three”: each group forms a dotted-quarter main beat. The dotted-quarter tempo in B is 72 beats per minute, with two main beats per measure. A 3/4 measure can also contain six eighth notes, but normally groups them as three quarter-note beats with two subdivisions each. Equal note counts therefore need not imply equal metrical organization. Listen for the grouping while remembering that tempo and musical context can affect how performers feel the pulse.

### Listen for

Both clips play six Cs at the same intervals. Tap on notes 1, 3, and 5 in A and on notes 1 and 4 in B. Listen for three main beats in A and two in B.

Each clip repeats the same bar. Listen once, then tap only the main beats in the second bar.

```piano
{"label":"A · 3/4 (2+2+2)","duration":3.334,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,104],[60,0.278,0.21,55],[60,0.556,0.21,86],[60,0.833,0.21,55],[60,1.111,0.21,86],[60,1.389,0.21,55],[60,1.667,0.21,104],[60,1.945,0.21,55],[60,2.223,0.21,86],[60,2.5,0.21,55],[60,2.778,0.21,86],[60,3.056,0.21,55]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 6/8 (3+3)","duration":3.334,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,104],[60,0.278,0.21,55],[60,0.556,0.21,55],[60,0.833,0.21,86],[60,1.111,0.21,55],[60,1.389,0.21,55],[60,1.667,0.21,104],[60,1.945,0.21,55],[60,2.223,0.21,55],[60,2.5,0.21,86],[60,2.778,0.21,55],[60,3.056,0.21,55]]}
```

A synthesized teaching example using Western notation and twelve-tone equal temperament. It does not reproduce a live performance’s timbre or dynamics.

### References

[Open Music Theory · Compound Meter and Time Signatures](https://pressbooks.nebraska.edu/openmusictheory/chapter/compound-meters-and-time-signatures/)

ja.title: 6/8拍子の大きな2拍
ja.description:
通常は付点4分音符を大きな1拍とし、各拍を8分音符3つに分けます。6音あっても大きな拍が6つとは限りません。

![Aは3/4で8分音符6個を2+2+2に、Bは6/8で3+3にまとめた楽譜](asset:music-common-triple-compound-score)

### 拍と音を結びつける

六つの8分音符を「1・2・3、1・2・3」と二組にすると、各組が付点4分音符の主拍になる。Bの速さは付点4分音符=72なので、毎分72の主拍が一小節に二つ入る。3/4でも8分音符六つは入るが、通常は二つずつを三拍にまとめる。同じ音符数でも拍の組織は異なり、拍の感じ方には速さや音楽の文脈も関わる。

### 聴くポイント

どちらも同じ高さのドが等間隔で6回鳴ります。Aは1・3・5番目、Bは1・4番目の音で足を踏み、主拍がそれぞれ3回と2回に感じられるか確かめましょう。

どちらも同じ小節を2回繰り返します。1小節目を聴き、2小節目で大きな拍だけを手で刻みましょう。

```piano
{"label":"A · 3/4 (2+2+2)","duration":3.334,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,104],[60,0.278,0.21,55],[60,0.556,0.21,86],[60,0.833,0.21,55],[60,1.111,0.21,86],[60,1.389,0.21,55],[60,1.667,0.21,104],[60,1.945,0.21,55],[60,2.223,0.21,86],[60,2.5,0.21,55],[60,2.778,0.21,86],[60,3.056,0.21,55]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 6/8 (3+3)","duration":3.334,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,104],[60,0.278,0.21,55],[60,0.556,0.21,55],[60,0.833,0.21,86],[60,1.111,0.21,55],[60,1.389,0.21,55],[60,1.667,0.21,104],[60,1.945,0.21,55],[60,2.223,0.21,55],[60,2.5,0.21,86],[60,2.778,0.21,55],[60,3.056,0.21,55]]}
```

西洋記譜法と12平均律による学習用合成音の例です。実演の音色や強弱を再現するものではありません。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Compound Meter and Time Signatures](https://pressbooks.nebraska.edu/openmusictheory/chapter/compound-meters-and-time-signatures/)

zh-TW.title: 6/8拍的兩個大拍
zh-TW.description:
通常以附點四分音符為一個大拍，每拍再分為三個八分音符。六個音不一定代表六個大拍。

![A 是 3/4，六個八分音符連成 2+2+2。B 是 6/8，連成 3+3。](asset:music-common-triple-compound-score)

### 連結拍點與聲音

把六個八分音符分成「一二三、一二三」兩組，每組就是附點四分音符的一個主拍。B 的附點四分音符速度是每分鐘 72 拍，即每分鐘72個主拍，每小節兩拍。3/4也能放六個八分音符，但通常兩個一組，共三個四分音符拍。因此音符數相同不表示拍子組織相同，聽分組時也要考慮速度與音樂脈絡。

### 聆聽重點

兩段都以相同的間隔奏六個同音高的 C。跟著 A 的第 1、3、5 音和 B 的第 1、4 音打拍子，聽聽主拍如何從三拍變成兩拍。

每段都重複同一小節兩次。先聽第一小節，再用手打出第二小節的大拍。

```piano
{"label":"A · 3/4（2+2+2）","duration":3.334,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,104],[60,0.278,0.21,55],[60,0.556,0.21,86],[60,0.833,0.21,55],[60,1.111,0.21,86],[60,1.389,0.21,55],[60,1.667,0.21,104],[60,1.945,0.21,55],[60,2.223,0.21,86],[60,2.5,0.21,55],[60,2.778,0.21,86],[60,3.056,0.21,55]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 6/8（3+3）","duration":3.334,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,104],[60,0.278,0.21,55],[60,0.556,0.21,55],[60,0.833,0.21,86],[60,1.111,0.21,55],[60,1.389,0.21,55],[60,1.667,0.21,104],[60,1.945,0.21,55],[60,2.223,0.21,55],[60,2.5,0.21,86],[60,2.778,0.21,55],[60,3.056,0.21,55]]}
```

這是使用西方記譜法與十二平均律的學習用合成音範例，不模擬現場演奏的音色或力度。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Compound Meter and Time Signatures](https://pressbooks.nebraska.edu/openmusictheory/chapter/compound-meters-and-time-signatures/)

cards.title: 악센트
cards.summary: 주변보다 특정 음 하나의 시작을 도드라지게 연주하라는 표시
cards.description:
악센트 기호 >는 붙어 있는 음이나 화음을 주변보다 도드라지게 연주하라는 뜻이다. 음표 위나 아래에 붙을 수 있다.

![악센트 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-accent-score)

### 들어 보기

A는 같은 도 네 개를 고르게 칩니다. B는 둘째 음의 시작만 두드러집니다. 두 예 모두 음이 시작되는 간격과 길이는 같습니다.

```piano
{"label":"A · 고르게","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 둘째 음에 >","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,104],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### 구별할 점

특정 음의 강조와 박자상 강한 위치는 다를 수 있다. >가 붙었다고 박을 늘이거나 이후 모든 음을 크게 치라는 뜻은 아니다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

en-US.title: Accent
en-US.summary: A mark asking a performer to stress one note relative to its neighbors
en-US.description:
The accent mark > asks the performer to give the marked note or chord extra emphasis. It can appear above or below the note.

![Accent · Example score](asset:music-common-accent-score)

### Listen for

A plays four Cs evenly. In B, listen for the attack of the second note to stand out. Both clips keep the same note spacing and duration.

```piano
{"label":"A · Even attacks","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · > on note two","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,104],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### Distinguish

The marked note can fall on a weak beat. The mark does not change the written beat length or set a new dynamic for the passage.

### Sources

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

ja.title: アクセント
ja.summary: 周囲より一つの音をはっきり強調する指示
ja.description:
アクセント記号 > は、付いている音や和音を周囲より目立たせる指示である。音符の上にも下にも書かれる。

![アクセント · 譜例](asset:music-common-accent-score)

### 聴くポイント

Aは同じ高さのドを四つ均等に弾きます。Bでは2番目の音の立ち上がりだけが際立ちます。音を出す間隔も長さも同じです。

```piano
{"label":"A · 均等な打鍵","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 2番目の音に >","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,104],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### 見分け方

弱拍の音にも付けられる。拍の長さや、その後の区間全体の強さを指定する記号ではない。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

zh-TW.title: 重音記號
zh-TW.summary: 要求演奏者突顯某一個音的符號
zh-TW.description:
重音記號 > 要求演奏者把標記的音或和弦奏得比周圍更突出。可寫在音符上方或下方。

![重音記號 · 譜例](asset:music-common-accent-score)

### 聆聽重點

A 均勻奏四個同音高的 C。聽聽 B 的第二音如何突出。兩段的起音間隔和音長相同。

```piano
{"label":"A · 均勻起音","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 第二音加 >","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,104],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### 辨別重點

標記也可以落在弱拍。它不改變記譜拍長，也不替後續整段設定力度。

### 來源

cards.title: 셈여림
cards.summary: 음악이 진행되는 동안 소리의 상대적인 세기를 나타내는 요소
cards.description:
셈여림은 소리의 상대적인 세기를 나타낸다. p는 여리게, f는 세게 연주하라는 뜻이다.

![셈여림 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-dynamics-score)

### 들어 보기

A와 B는 같은 도 네 개를 같은 속도로 연주합니다. A는 네 음이 모두 여리고 B는 네 음이 모두 셉니다. 한 음이 튀는 대신 구간 전체의 세기가 달라지는지 들어 보세요.

```piano
{"label":"A · p · 여리게","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,46],[60,1.25,0.56,46],[60,1.875,0.56,46]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · f · 세게","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,100],[60,0.625,0.56,100],[60,1.25,0.56,100],[60,1.875,0.56,100]]}
```

### 구별할 점

p와 f는 고정된 데시벨 값이 아니다. 곡, 악기, 함께 연주하는 소리에 맞춰 상대적인 세기를 판단한다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

en-US.title: Dynamics
en-US.summary: The relative levels of loudness as music unfolds
en-US.description:
Dynamics indicate relative loudness. The mark p asks for a soft sound and f asks for a loud sound.

![Dynamics · Example score](asset:music-common-dynamics-score)

### Listen for

Both clips play four Cs at the same speed. In A all four notes are soft. In B all four are loud. Listen for the change in level across the whole passage.

```piano
{"label":"A · p · softly","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,46],[60,1.25,0.56,46],[60,1.875,0.56,46]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · f · loudly","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,100],[60,0.625,0.56,100],[60,1.25,0.56,100],[60,1.875,0.56,100]]}
```

### Distinguish

The marks do not specify fixed decibel levels. Interpret them in relation to the piece, the instrument, and other performers.

### Sources

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

ja.title: 強弱
ja.summary: 音楽の中で音の相対的な強さを表す要素
ja.description:
強弱は音の相対的な強さを表す。p は弱く、f は強く演奏する指示である。

![強弱 · 譜例](asset:music-common-dynamics-score)

### 聴くポイント

AもBも同じ速さでドを四つ弾きます。Aは四音とも弱く、Bは四音とも強く弾きます。区間全体の音の強さの違いを聴きましょう。

```piano
{"label":"A · p · 弱く","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,46],[60,1.25,0.56,46],[60,1.875,0.56,46]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · f · 強く","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,100],[60,0.625,0.56,100],[60,1.25,0.56,100],[60,1.875,0.56,100]]}
```

### 見分け方

決まったデシベル値ではない。曲、楽器、共演者の響きに合わせて強さを判断する。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

zh-TW.title: 力度
zh-TW.summary: 音樂進行中聲音相對強弱的要素
zh-TW.description:
力度表示聲音的相對強弱。p 表示較弱地演奏，f 表示較強地演奏。

![力度 · 譜例](asset:music-common-dynamics-score)

### 聆聽重點

兩段都以相同速度奏四個 C。A 的四音都輕，B 的四音都重。比較整段的力度。

```piano
{"label":"A · p · 弱奏","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,46],[60,1.25,0.56,46],[60,1.875,0.56,46]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · f · 強奏","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,100],[60,0.625,0.56,100],[60,1.25,0.56,100],[60,1.875,0.56,100]]}
```

### 辨別重點

這不是固定的分貝數，須依樂曲、樂器和其他演奏者的聲音相對判斷。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

cards.title: 크레셴도
cards.summary: 진행하면서 소리의 세기를 점차 높이라는 표시
cards.description:
크레셴도는 소리를 점차 세게 하라는 뜻이다. 점점 벌어지는 쐐기나 cresc.로 적는다.

![크레셴도 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-crescendo-score)

### 들어 보기

A의 도 네 음은 첫 음부터 마지막 음까지 같은 세기입니다. B에서는 같은 간격으로 치면서 음마다 조금씩 세기가 커집니다.

```piano
{"label":"A · 같은 세기","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,46],[60,1.25,0.56,46],[60,1.875,0.56,46]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 점점 세게","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,63],[60,1.25,0.56,81],[60,1.875,0.56,100]]}
```

### 구별할 점

빠르게 연주하라는 뜻이 아니다. 마지막 음의 세기는 도착점의 기호나 프레이즈에 따라 정한다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

en-US.title: Crescendo
en-US.summary: A direction to make the sound progressively louder
en-US.description:
A crescendo is a gradual increase in loudness. It is written as an opening hairpin or cresc.

![Crescendo · Example score](asset:music-common-crescendo-score)

### Listen for

A plays four Cs at a steady level. B keeps the same spacing and grows louder with every note.

```piano
{"label":"A · Steady level","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,46],[60,1.25,0.56,46],[60,1.875,0.56,46]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · Growing louder","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,63],[60,1.25,0.56,81],[60,1.875,0.56,100]]}
```

### Distinguish

It does not ask for a faster tempo. The ending loudness depends on the destination marking or phrase.

### Sources

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

ja.title: クレッシェンド
ja.summary: 進行に合わせて音を次第に強くする指示
ja.description:
クレッシェンドは少しずつ強くする指示で、開いていくヘアピンや cresc. で表す。

![クレッシェンド · 譜例](asset:music-common-crescendo-score)

### 聴くポイント

Aはドを四つ同じ強さで弾きます。Bは音を出す間隔を保ちながら、一音ずつ強くなります。

```piano
{"label":"A · 同じ強さ","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,46],[60,1.25,0.56,46],[60,1.875,0.56,46]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · だんだん強く","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,63],[60,1.25,0.56,81],[60,1.875,0.56,100]]}
```

### 見分け方

速くする指示ではない。最後の強さは到達点の記号やフレーズによる。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

zh-TW.title: 漸強
zh-TW.summary: 讓聲音隨著進行逐步變強的指示
zh-TW.description:
漸強表示逐漸加強力度，常用逐步張開的髮夾記號或 cresc. 表示。

![漸強 · 譜例](asset:music-common-crescendo-score)

### 聆聽重點

A 的四個 C 一樣大聲。B 保持相同的起音間隔，每個音比前一個更強。

```piano
{"label":"A · 力度相同","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,46],[60,1.25,0.56,46],[60,1.875,0.56,46]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 漸強","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,46],[60,0.625,0.56,63],[60,1.25,0.56,81],[60,1.875,0.56,100]]}
```

### 辨別重點

速度不必增加。最後要多強，取決於目標力度或樂句。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

cards.title: 디미누엔도
cards.summary: 진행하면서 소리의 세기를 점차 낮추라는 표시
cards.description:
디미누엔도는 소리를 점차 여리게 하라는 뜻이다. 닫혀 가는 쐐기나 dim.으로 적으며, decresc.도 같은 방향을 나타낸다.

![디미누엔도 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-diminuendo-score)

### 들어 보기

A의 도 네 음은 첫 음부터 마지막 음까지 같은 세기입니다. B에서는 같은 간격으로 치면서 음마다 조금씩 세기가 줄어듭니다.

```piano
{"label":"A · 같은 세기","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,100],[60,0.625,0.56,100],[60,1.25,0.56,100],[60,1.875,0.56,100]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 점점 여리게","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,100],[60,0.625,0.56,81],[60,1.25,0.56,63],[60,1.875,0.56,46]]}
```

### 구별할 점

느리게 하거나 꼭 무음까지 줄이라는 뜻은 아니다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

en-US.title: Diminuendo
en-US.summary: A direction to make the sound progressively softer
en-US.description:
A diminuendo is a gradual decrease in loudness. It is written as a closing hairpin or dim. The abbreviation decresc. indicates the same direction.

![Diminuendo · Example score](asset:music-common-diminuendo-score)

### Listen for

A plays four Cs at a steady level. B keeps the same spacing and grows softer with every note.

```piano
{"label":"A · Steady level","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,100],[60,0.625,0.56,100],[60,1.25,0.56,100],[60,1.875,0.56,100]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · Growing softer","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,100],[60,0.625,0.56,81],[60,1.25,0.56,63],[60,1.875,0.56,46]]}
```

### Distinguish

It does not mean slow down or necessarily fade to silence.

### Sources

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

![ディミヌエンド · 譜例](asset:music-common-diminuendo-score)

### 聴くポイント

Aはドを四つ同じ強さで弾きます。Bは音を出す間隔を保ちながら、一音ずつ弱くなります。

cards.title: 마르카토
cards.summary: 음표 위나 아래의 쐐기 모양으로 뚜렷하고 힘찬 강조를 지시하는 기호
cards.description:
마르카토는 음을 뚜렷하고 힘 있게 연주하라는 지시다. 악상에 따라 ^ 모양의 기호로 표기된다.

![마르카토 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-marcato-score)

### 들어 보기

A는 같은 도 네 개를 고르게 칩니다. B에서는 둘째 음의 힘찬 시작과 짧게 놓는 소리를 들어 보세요. 여기서는 두 방식으로 둘째 음을 또렷하게 살렸습니다.

```piano
{"label":"A · 고르게","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 둘째 음에 ^","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.4,116],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### 구별할 점

악센트보다 강하게 해석하는 경우가 많지만, 소리의 세기와 길이는 악기와 문맥에 따라 달라진다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

ko.summary: 음표 위나 아래의 쐐기 모양으로 뚜렷하고 힘찬 강조를 지시하는 기호
ko.description:
마르카토는 음을 뚜렷하고 힘 있게 연주하라는 지시다. 악상에 따라 ^ 모양의 기호로 표기된다.

![마르카토 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-marcato-score)

### 들어 보기

A는 같은 도 네 개를 고르게 칩니다. B에서는 둘째 음의 힘찬 시작과 짧게 놓는 소리를 들어 보세요. 여기서는 두 방식으로 둘째 음을 또렷하게 살렸습니다.

```piano
{"label":"A · 고르게","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 둘째 음에 ^","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.4,116],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### 구별할 점

악센트보다 강하게 해석하는 경우가 많지만, 소리의 세기와 길이는 악기와 문맥에 따라 달라진다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

en-US.title: Marcato
en-US.summary: A wedge-shaped direction for a strongly marked attack
en-US.description:
Marcato asks for a distinctly marked, forceful note. It can be shown with a wedge like ^ above or below the note.

![Marcato · Example score](asset:music-common-marcato-score)

### Listen for

A plays four Cs evenly. In B, listen for the forceful start and quick release of the second note. This example uses both to make that note stand out.

```piano
{"label":"A · Even attacks","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · ^ on note two","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.4,116],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### Distinguish

It is often stronger than an ordinary accent, but loudness and duration depend on the instrument and context.

### Sources

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

ja.title: マルカート
ja.summary: くさび形で音をはっきり力強く出すように指示する記号
ja.description:
マルカートは音をはっきり力強く演奏する指示で、^ に似たくさび形で示すことがある。

![マルカート · 譜例](asset:music-common-marcato-score)

### 聴くポイント

Aは同じ高さのドを四つ均等に弾きます。Bでは2番目の音を力強く出し、早めに切ります。この例ではその両方で音を際立たせています。

```piano
{"label":"A · 均等な打鍵","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 2番目の音に ^","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.4,116],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### 見分け方

普通のアクセントより強く解釈することが多いが、音量や長さは楽器と文脈による。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

zh-TW.title: 強調奏法
zh-TW.summary: 以楔形記號提示鮮明而有力起音的奏法
zh-TW.description:
Marcato 指示把音奏得鮮明有力，可用類似 ^ 的楔形記號標在音符上方或下方。

![強調奏法 · 譜例](asset:music-common-marcato-score)

### 聆聽重點

A 均勻奏四個同音高的 C。聽 B 的第二音如何有力地起音，又很快收住。這個例子用這兩種方式讓重音更鮮明。

```piano
{"label":"A · 均勻起音","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 第二音加 ^","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.4,116],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### 辨別重點

通常比一般重音更強，但實際力度與長短仍取決於樂器和情境。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

cards.title: 스포르찬도
cards.summary: 표시된 음이나 화음에 갑자기 강한 힘을 싣도록 하는 약어
cards.description:
스포르찬도는 음이나 화음을 갑자기 강하게 강조하라는 뜻이며 보통 sfz로 표시한다.

![스포르찬도 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-sforzando-score)

### 들어 보기

A는 같은 도 네 개를 고르게 칩니다. B에서는 둘째 음이 순간적으로 훨씬 세게 울리고 셋째 음부터 원래 세기로 돌아옵니다.

```piano
{"label":"A · 같은 세기","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 둘째 음에 sfz","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,124],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### 구별할 점

f가 구간의 세기 수준을 지정하는 것과 달리 이 기호는 표시된 위치의 강조에 초점을 둔다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

en-US.title: Sforzando
en-US.summary: An abbreviated direction for a sudden strong emphasis on a marked note or chord
en-US.description:
Sforzando is a sudden, forceful emphasis on a note or chord. It is commonly marked sfz.

![Sforzando · Example score](asset:music-common-sforzando-score)

### Listen for

A plays four Cs evenly. In B, the second note is suddenly much stronger, and the third note returns to the original level.

```piano
{"label":"A · Steady level","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · sfz on note two","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,124],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### Distinguish

Unlike a new f level for the passage, sfz calls attention to the marked event.

### Sources

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

ja.title: スフォルツァンド
ja.summary: 印のある音や和音を急に強く響かせる略号
ja.description:
スフォルツァンドは音や和音を急に強調する指示で、ふつう sfz と書く。

![スフォルツァンド · 譜例](asset:music-common-sforzando-score)

### 聴くポイント

Aは同じ高さのドを四つ均等に弾きます。Bでは2番目の音が急に強く響き、3番目の音で元の強さに戻ります。

```piano
{"label":"A · 同じ強さ","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 2番目の音に sfz","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,124],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### 見分け方

区間の強さを切り替える f に対し、sfz は記号の位置に注意を向ける。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

zh-TW.title: 突強
zh-TW.summary: 指示標記的音或和弦突然有力奏出的縮寫
zh-TW.description:
Sforzando 是某個音或和弦突然強調的指示，通常寫作 sfz。

![突強 · 譜例](asset:music-common-sforzando-score)

### 聆聽重點

A 均勻奏四個同音高的 C。B 的第二音突然強了許多，第三音就回到原本的力度。

```piano
{"label":"A · 力度相同","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,64],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 第二音加 sfz","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.56,64],[60,0.625,0.56,124],[60,1.25,0.56,64],[60,1.875,0.56,64]]}
```

### 辨別重點

f 可指定接下來一段的力度，而 sfz 著重標記當下的音。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

cards.title: 스타카토
cards.summary: 음표 위나 아래의 점으로 음 사이를 분리하라는 표시
cards.description:
스타카토는 음과 음 사이를 떼어 연주하라는 지시다. 보통 음표의 위나 아래에 점을 찍는다.

![스타카토 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-staccato-score)

### 들어 보기

두 예 모두 도·레·미·파가 같은 박에 시작합니다. B에서는 각 음이 A보다 일찍 끝나므로 음 사이가 더 넓게 들립니다.

```piano
{"label":"A · 보통 길이","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.55,64],[62,0.625,0.55,64],[64,1.25,0.55,64],[65,1.875,0.55,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 짧게 떼어","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,64],[62,0.625,0.21,64],[64,1.25,0.21,64],[65,1.875,0.21,64]]}
```

### 구별할 점

음표 오른쪽의 점음표 표시와 다르다. 연주 길이가 정확히 반으로 줄어든다는 뜻도 아니다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

localizedAltText.ja: スタッカート · 譜例

relations.value: 같은 간격으로 시작할 때 음 사이가 비는 경우와 음 길이를 충분히 유지하는 경우를 비교한다.

ko.summary: 음표 위나 아래의 점으로 음 사이를 분리하라는 표시

en-US.title: Staccato
en-US.summary: A dot above or below a note asking for separation between sounds
en-US.description:
Staccato asks for notes to be played with separation. Its usual mark is a dot above or below the note.

![Staccato · Example score](asset:music-common-staccato-score)

### Listen for

In both clips, C–D–E–F start on the same beats. In B, each note ends sooner, leaving more space before the next.

```piano
{"label":"A · Ordinary length","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.55,64],[62,0.625,0.55,64],[64,1.25,0.55,64],[65,1.875,0.55,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · Short and detached","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,64],[62,0.625,0.21,64],[64,1.25,0.21,64],[65,1.875,0.21,64]]}
```

### Distinguish

A duration dot is written to the right of a note. A staccato note does not have to last exactly half its written value.

### Sources

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

ja.title: スタッカート
ja.summary: 音符の上下の点で音を離して演奏する指示
ja.description:
スタッカートは音と音を離して演奏する指示で、ふつう音符の上か下に点を打つ。

![スタッカート · 譜例](asset:music-common-staccato-score)

### 聴くポイント

どちらもド・レ・ミ・ファを同じ拍で弾き始めます。Bは一音ずつ早く切れるので、次の音までのすき間が広く聞こえます。

```piano
{"label":"A · 通常の長さ","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.55,64],[62,0.625,0.55,64],[64,1.25,0.55,64],[65,1.875,0.55,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 短く切って","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,64],[62,0.625,0.21,64],[64,1.25,0.21,64],[65,1.875,0.21,64]]}
```

### 見分け方

音符の右側に付く付点とは違う。長さが必ず半分になるわけでもない。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

zh-TW.title: 斷奏
zh-TW.summary: 以音符上下的點提示音與音之間留空
zh-TW.description:
斷奏指示把音分開演奏，符號通常是音符上方或下方的一個點。

![斷奏 · 譜例](asset:music-common-staccato-score)

### 聆聽重點

兩段都在相同的拍點奏出 C–D–E–F。B 的每個音較早結束，因此音與音之間的空隙較大。

```piano
{"label":"A · 一般音長","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.55,64],[62,0.625,0.55,64],[64,1.25,0.55,64],[65,1.875,0.55,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 短促分離","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.21,64],[62,0.625,0.21,64],[64,1.25,0.21,64],[65,1.875,0.21,64]]}
```

### 辨別重點

附點寫在音符右邊。斷奏也不要求固定縮成原記譜時值的一半。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

cards.title: 레가토
cards.summary: 다음 음으로 이어지는 소리를 매끄럽게 연결하는 연주 방식
cards.description:
레가토는 음 사이가 매끄럽게 이어지게 연주하는 방식이다. 악보에 legato라는 말이나 이음줄로 나타낼 수 있다.

![레가토 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-legato-score)

### 들어 보기

도·레·미·파의 음높이가 바뀌는 순간에 귀를 기울여 보세요. A는 다음 음 전에 작은 틈이 들리고, B는 다음 음을 시작할 때까지 앞 음이 이어집니다.

```piano
{"label":"A · 음 사이에 틈","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.39,64],[62,0.625,0.39,64],[64,1.25,0.39,64],[65,1.875,0.39,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 매끄럽게 연결","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.628,64],[62,0.625,0.628,64],[64,1.25,0.628,64],[65,1.875,0.609,64]]}
```

### 구별할 점

각 음의 높이는 여전히 바뀐다. 같은 음의 길이를 더해 한 번만 발음하는 붙임줄과 기능이 다르다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)


### 구별할 점

각 음의 높이는 여전히 바뀐다. 같은 음의 길이를 더해 한 번만 발음하는 붙임줄과 기능이 다르다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

en-US.title: Legato
en-US.summary: A way of playing that joins successive notes smoothly
en-US.description:
Legato means to play successive notes smoothly connected. A score may indicate it with the word legato or a slur.

![Legato · Example score](asset:music-common-legato-score)

### Listen for

Listen where C–D–E–F change pitch. A leaves a small gap before each new note. In B, the previous note carries into the next attack.

```piano
{"label":"A · With gaps","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.39,64],[62,0.625,0.39,64],[64,1.25,0.39,64],[65,1.875,0.39,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · Smoothly joined","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.628,64],[62,0.625,0.628,64],[64,1.25,0.628,64],[65,1.875,0.609,64]]}
```

### Distinguish

The pitches still change. A tie instead adds the durations of notes of the same pitch into one sustained sound.

### Sources

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

ja.title: レガート
ja.summary: 続く音同士を滑らかにつなぐ奏法
ja.description:
レガートは音と音を滑らかにつないで演奏する奏法である。楽譜には legato やスラーで示すことがある。

![レガート · 譜例](asset:music-common-legato-score)

### 聴くポイント

ド・レ・ミ・ファの音高が変わる瞬間を聴きましょう。Aは次の音までに少しすき間があり、Bは次の音が始まるところまで前の音が続きます。

```piano
{"label":"A · 音の間にすき間","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.39,64],[62,0.625,0.39,64],[64,1.25,0.39,64],[65,1.875,0.39,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · なめらかにつなぐ","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.628,64],[62,0.625,0.628,64],[64,1.25,0.628,64],[65,1.875,0.609,64]]}
```

### 見分け方

音高は一音ずつ変わる。同じ高さを一度の発音で伸ばすタイとは働きが異なる。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

zh-TW.title: 連奏
zh-TW.summary: 把前後音平順連起來的演奏方式
zh-TW.description:
連奏是把不同音平順接起來的奏法，譜上可寫成 legato 或以圓滑線表示。

![連奏 · 譜例](asset:music-common-legato-score)

### 聆聽重點

注意 C–D–E–F 改變音高的地方。A 在下一個音之前留有小空隙，B 的前一個音持續到下一個音開始為止。

```piano
{"label":"A · 音與音之間留空","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.39,64],[62,0.625,0.39,64],[64,1.25,0.39,64],[65,1.875,0.39,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 平順相連","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.628,64],[62,0.625,0.628,64],[64,1.25,0.628,64],[65,1.875,0.609,64]]}
```

### 辨別重點

音高仍然逐一改變。延音線則把同音高的音時值相加，只起音一次。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

cards.title: 이음줄
cards.summary: 둘 이상의 음을 한 흐름으로 연주하도록 잇는 곡선
cards.description:
이음줄은 여러 음을 하나의 흐름으로 묶는 곡선이다. 악기나 문맥에 따라 매끄러운 연결, 한 호흡이나 한 활에서의 처리 등을 약속한다.

![이음줄 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-slur-score)

### 들어 보기

A는 이음줄로 묶인 도와 레입니다. 매끄럽게 이어지지만 레에서 새 음이 시작됩니다. B는 붙임줄로 이은 도 두 개입니다. 한 번 시작한 도의 소리가 두 음표에 적힌 길이만큼 이어집니다.

```piano
{"label":"A · 이음줄 · 도에서 레로","duration":1.25,"notes":[[60,0,0.628,64],[62,0.625,0.609,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 붙임줄 · 도 한 번","duration":1.25,"notes":[[60,0,1.234,64]]}
```

### 구별할 점

곡선 모양만으로 이름을 정하기 어렵다. 묶인 음과 문맥을 함께 본다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

relations.value: 한 소리로 이은 같은 높이 두 음표와 서로 다른 음을 한 구절로 잇는 경우를 비교한다.

ko.title: 이음줄
ko.summary: 둘 이상의 음을 한 흐름으로 연주하도록 잇는 곡선

이음줄은 여러 음을 하나의 흐름으로 묶는 곡선이다. 악기나 문맥에 따라 매끄러운 연결, 한 호흡이나 한 활에서의 처리 등을 약속한다.

en-US.title: Slur
en-US.summary: A curved line grouping notes into a connected gesture
en-US.description:
A slur groups notes into a connected gesture. Depending on the instrument or context, it can indicate smooth connection, a breath group, or playing under one bow.

![Slur · Example score](asset:music-common-slur-score)

### Listen for

In A, a slur joins C to D. The transition is smooth and D has its own attack. In B, a tie across two written Cs gives one attack and a sound that lasts for the combined durations.

```piano
{"label":"A · Slur · C to D","duration":1.25,"notes":[[60,0,0.628,64],[62,0.625,0.609,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · Tie · one sustained C","duration":1.25,"notes":[[60,0,1.234,64]]}
```

### Distinguish

The two curves look similar. Check the notes they connect and their context.

### Sources

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

ja.title: スラー
ja.summary: 複数の音を一つの流れにまとめる曲線
ja.description:
スラーは複数の音を一つの流れにまとめる曲線である。楽器や文脈によって、なめらかな接続、一息、一弓などを示す。

![スラー · 譜例](asset:music-common-slur-score)

### 聴くポイント

Aはスラーでつないだドとレです。なめらかにつながり、レで新しい音が鳴ります。Bはド二つをタイで結んだ例です。ドを一度だけ鳴らし、音符二つ分の長さを保ちます。

```piano
{"label":"A · スラー · ドからレへ","duration":1.25,"notes":[[60,0,0.628,64],[62,0.625,0.609,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · タイ · ドを一度だけ","duration":1.25,"notes":[[60,0,1.234,64]]}
```

### 見分け方

形が似ているので、結ばれた音と文脈を確認する。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

zh-TW.title: 圓滑線
zh-TW.summary: 把數個音組織成一個演奏動作的曲線
zh-TW.description:
圓滑線把數個音組合成連貫的演奏動作。依樂器或情境，可能表示平順連接、同一口氣或同一弓。

![圓滑線 · 譜例](asset:music-common-slur-score)

### 聆聽重點

A 用圓滑線連接 C 和 D。兩音平順銜接，D 仍有自己的起音。B 用延音線連接兩個 C，只起音一次，將兩個音符的時值合在一起。

```piano
{"label":"A · 圓滑線 · C 接 D","duration":1.25,"notes":[[60,0,0.628,64],[62,0.625,0.609,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 延音線 · C 起音一次","duration":1.25,"notes":[[60,0,1.234,64]]}
```

### 辨別重點

兩種曲線形狀相似，要看它連接的音與情境。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

cards.title: 테누토
cards.summary: 짧은 가로선으로 음을 충분히 유지하라고 지시하는 기호
cards.description:
테누토는 음표 위나 아래의 짧은 가로선으로, 음의 길이를 충분히 살려 연주하라는 지시다. 문맥에 따라 무게를 실을 수도 있다.

![테누토 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-tenuto-score)

### 들어 보기

두 예 모두 도·레·미·파를 같은 간격으로 연주합니다. B에서는 각 음을 적힌 길이만큼 유지합니다. 다음 음이 없는 마지막 파도 한 박을 채우는지 들어 보세요.

```piano
{"label":"A · 짧게 연주","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.31,64],[62,0.625,0.31,64],[64,1.25,0.31,64],[65,1.875,0.31,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 적힌 길이만큼 유지","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.6,64],[62,0.625,0.6,64],[64,1.25,0.6,64],[65,1.875,0.6,64]]}
```

### 구별할 점

박의 간격을 임의로 늘이거나 모두 세게 연주한다는 뜻은 아니다.

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

relations.value: 같은 간격으로 시작할 때 음 사이가 비는 경우와 음 길이를 충분히 유지하는 경우를 비교한다.

ko.title: 테누토
ko.summary: 짧은 가로선으로 음을 충분히 유지하라고 지시하는 기호
ko.description:
테누토는 음표 위나 아래의 짧은 가로선으로, 음의 길이를 충분히 살려 연주하라는 지시다. 문맥에 따라 무게를 실을 수도 있다.

![테누토 · 예시 악보](asset:music-common-tenuto-score)

en-US.title: Tenuto
en-US.summary: A short horizontal line asking for a note to be sustained for its value
en-US.description:
Tenuto is shown as a short horizontal line above or below the note. It asks the performer to sustain the note for its value, sometimes with added weight.

![Tenuto · Example score](asset:music-common-tenuto-score)

### Listen for

Both clips play C–D–E–F at the same intervals. In B each note is held for its written value. Listen for the last F to fill a beat too, even with no note after it.

```piano
{"label":"A · Shorter notes","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.31,64],[62,0.625,0.31,64],[64,1.25,0.31,64],[65,1.875,0.31,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · Held to full value","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.6,64],[62,0.625,0.6,64],[64,1.25,0.6,64],[65,1.875,0.6,64]]}
```

### Distinguish

It does not necessarily stretch the beat or make every note loud.

### Sources

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

ja.title: テヌート
ja.summary: 短い横線で音の長さを十分に保つよう求める記号
ja.description:
テヌートは音符の上下の短い横線で、音価を十分に保つ指示である。文脈によって重みを加えることもある。

![テヌート · 譜例](asset:music-common-tenuto-score)

### 聴くポイント

どちらもド・レ・ミ・ファを同じ間隔で弾きます。Bでは一音ずつ音価いっぱいまで保ちます。後ろに音がない最後のファも一拍分続くことを聴き取りましょう。

```piano
{"label":"A · 短めに弾く","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.31,64],[62,0.625,0.31,64],[64,1.25,0.31,64],[65,1.875,0.31,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 音価いっぱいまで保つ","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.6,64],[62,0.625,0.6,64],[64,1.25,0.6,64],[65,1.875,0.6,64]]}
```

### 見分け方

拍の間隔を勝手に伸ばしたり、すべて強く弾いたりする指示ではない。

### 出典

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

zh-TW.title: 保持音記號
zh-TW.summary: 用短橫線要求把音奏足時值的記號
zh-TW.description:
Tenuto 以音符上方或下方的短線表示，要求充分保持音的時值，有時也帶有重量感。

![保持音記號 · 譜例](asset:music-common-tenuto-score)

### 聆聽重點

兩段都以相同間隔奏出 C–D–E–F。B 把每個音的時值奏足。聽聽最後的 F，即使後面沒有下一個音，也維持了一拍。

```piano
{"label":"A · 每個音奏短","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.31,64],[62,0.625,0.31,64],[64,1.25,0.31,64],[65,1.875,0.31,64]]}
```

```piano
{"label":"B · 奏足時值","duration":2.5,"notes":[[60,0.0,0.6,64],[62,0.625,0.6,64],[64,1.25,0.6,64],[65,1.875,0.6,64]]}
```

### 辨別重點

不表示任意延長拍點間隔，也不表示所有音都要奏得很強。

### 來源

[Open Music Theory · Other Aspects of Notation](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/other-aspects-of-notation/)

cards.title: 음정
cards.summary: 두 음 사이의 거리를 음이름 개수와 반음 수로 구별한 것
cards.description:
음정은 두 음 사이의 거리다. 도수는 출발음과 도착음을 모두 포함해 음이름을 세고, 성질은 같은 도수 안의 반음 수를 비교해 정한다. C–E와 C–E♭은 둘 다 3도지만 각각 장3도와 단3도다.

### 악보 예시

![음정 예시 악보](asset:music-common-interval-score)

```abc
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
Q:1/4=96
K:C
C _E C E |
```

### 출처

[Open Music Theory · Intervals](https://viva.pressbooks.pub/openmusictheory/chapter/intervals/)

ko.title: 음정
ko.summary: 두 음 사이의 거리를 음이름 개수와 반음 수로 구별한 것
ko.description:
음정은 두 음 사이의 거리다. 도수는 출발음과 도착음을 모두 포함해 음이름을 세고, 성질은 같은 도수 안의 반음 수를 비교해 정한다. C–E와 C–E♭은 둘 다 3도지만 각각 장3도와 단3도다.
